findings.title: One canonical dashboard; historical page sets preserved in Git
findings.finding: The repository contains an unrelated legacy GEMS project and several earlier bathtub dashboards built by parallel sessions. This integration publishes one canonical, source-linked dashboard and retains earlier files in repository history rather than presenting conflicting live versions.

findings.title: The three estimates describe different scopes
findings.finding: The owner-reported scopes are adjustment/repair, lever/spout-diverter replacement, and waste-and-overflow replacement. They are not directly comparable. Amounts, dates per estimate, and drywall inclusions remain blank/unverified until written quotes are supplied.

findings.title: General SF has the clearest published combined scope
findings.finding: General SF's own building page lists sheetrock/tape/texture and its plumbing page lists plumbing repair/installation. CSLB shows active B, C-10, and C-36. This supports screening first, not a conclusion that it can perform this exact seized assembly or has availability.

findings.title: Handyman Heroes publishes wall repair plus plumbing
findings.finding: The company's handyman page lists sheetrock/wall repairs and says many multi-trade jobs can be handled by one team; CSLB shows active B and C-36. Review the complaint disclosure and the C-10 advertising discrepancy before selection.

findings.title: Heise's explicitly addresses rental units and tenant schedules
findings.finding: Heise's property-repair page lists drywall patching/touch-ups, rental-unit service, and respect for tenant schedules. Its checked CSLB record has C-36 but no B or C-9; confirm who handles ceiling opening/restoration and whether the advertised patching covers the required scope.

findings.title: A B + C-36 license is not proof of drywall service
findings.finding: Ace, Genteel, Rapid Flow, and Manny's hold B + C-36, but the reviewed company pages do not explicitly confirm ceiling drywall restoration for this job. License classification and actual service capability are separate fields.
findings.basis: CSLB records and company service pages

findings.title: Yelp is discovery, not verification of license or exact fit
findings.finding: Direct Yelp business/search fetches returned HTTP 403 in this environment, so current Yelp ratings/counts are blank and links are retained for manual reading. BBB profiles for Expert Plumbing Solutions, Fast Response, and Handyman Heroes were read directly; their platform-stated ratings/complaint fields are shown separately on the Reviews page and are not government licensing evidence.
findings.basis: Direct fetch attempts and search-index observations
findings.source_label: Example: Fast Response BBB profile (read directly)

findings.title: The installed mechanism is not identified
findings.finding: Watco instructions show a typical trip-lever assembly with linkage and drop cylinder connected to overflow/drain elbows behind/under the tub. They do not identify the installed brand/model or prove that forcing the lever is safe. Contractor diagnosis and compatible parts are required.

findings.title: Permit status is scope-dependent
findings.finding: SF DBI says a permit is needed before cutting into or replacing pipes, especially concealed pipes; Plumbing Code 104.2 lists limited exemptions. The dashboard does not classify this job as exempt. The contractor/DBI must determine requirements for the actual scope before work.
findings.basis: SF DBI and current code library

findings.title: Insurance and disclosures need job-specific review
findings.finding: Several CSLB records show workers' compensation exemptions based on no employees. Handyman Heroes has a disclosure-only citation; Advanced Plumbing has a future-suspension warning. These are regulator-record facts to review, not findings of wrongdoing.

findings.title: Contact and identity discrepancies are preserved, not silently corrected
findings.finding: CSLB and company/Yelp addresses or phones differ for several providers. Fast Response's CSLB street spelling is POTRAL; Heise's CSLB address differs from its Yelp storefront; Atlas, Discount, Advanced, and Rapid Flow have phone differences. Confirm the contracting entity and service location.
findings.basis: CSLB records compared with company/review sources

findings.title: No contractor has been contacted, confirmed, or booked
findings.finding: This session performed source research and site integration only. Availability, exact repair method, combined price, tenant protections, and agreement to work remain unconfirmed for every candidate.
findings.source_label: CSLB hiring guidance for next steps
